summary:
Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository, without running tests or mypy and without committing.

Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 as the last ControlType member; ControlCode union now includes Tuple[ControlType, str].
- rich/control.py: added the SET_WINDOW_TITLE formatter entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and the Control.title(title) classmethod with docstring.
- rich/console.py: added Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor. It checks only is_terminal, buffers a title control and returns True, or returns False with nothing buffered. Docstring covers the restore/reset caveats.
- rich/_windows_renderer.py: one new elif branch that calls term.set_title with the title from the control code.
- CHANGELOG.md: added an Unreleased "Added" bullet above "Fixed", linking pull request 2200.
- Tests: test_console.py (test_set_window_title, skipped on legacy Windows via detect_legacy_windows, which I imported), test_control.py (test_title), test_windows_renderer.py (test_control_set_window_title, Windows-only).

Unverified: none of the tests or mypy were run, per instructions. Changes were checked by reading only.
